Waul who is intent on his own sinister plan.

programmes.title: Atlantis: Milo's Return

Locals believe they are Spirits of War but others believe they are superior arms technology fabricated by the Moldova government..

Members of a Japanese submarine crew scout out the madness, along with a Captain in Germany's Kreigsmarine (Navy).

programmes.title: Good Luck! Ninomiya-kun

programmes.title: My First Girlfriend is a Gal

In his dream, he reaches out to feel Yuaka's breasts, and unconsciously does the same thing in reality, only to find a soft sensation in front of him. Junichi, surprised, awakens to find a rather large-breasted gal on top of him, but he has no clue who she is, and is confused by her gal-speak.

Yukana’s in a different outfit than usual in her house clothes, which is surprisingly stimulating to Junichi, and just when things seem to be getting good between them…

Elsewhere, the crew of the Deucalion prepares for battle at Trident Base. Learning of the existence of Slaine’s swift Tharsis, they are wary of its capabilities.

programmes.title: Aldnoah.Zero

Yagarai is concerned about the position this will put Yuki in, who has been assigned to a unit away from the Deucalion. Meanwhile, a group of Mars Knights who oppose the Earthborn Slaine’s rise to power plan a new attack on Earth in hopes of securing more power of their own.

programmes.title: Reincarnated as a Sword

Teacher appraises him and finds he abuses his skills to falsely accuse commoners and charm his superiors. August then demands all the dungeon loot as a fine for Fran lying to a noble.

programmes.title: Reincarnated as a Sword
programmes.description: Fran reveals it was the Blue Cats who systematically made the Black Cats weaker and discriminated against over centuries. The Blue Cat, Gyuran, gleefully describes torturing and murdering Black Cats. Fran is afraid until Teacher reminds her she is not alone.

programmes.title: Patlabor: The Movie

programmes.title: Mobile Suit Gundam MS IGLOO
programmes.episode_title: The Illusion That Lingers Over the Orbit
programmes.description: (U.C. 0079.10.24 - 0079.11.10) Upon news of a powerful new Federation mobile suit, Zeon propagandizes the Zudah, a mobile suit claimed to be superior to the Federation prototype. The 603rd is put in charge of testing the prototype with the help of a distinguished Zimmad test pilot Maj. Jean-Luc Duvall. However, the testing soon goes wrong after a fellow test pilot is killed when his Zudah lost control and disintegrated during combat simulation. To add salt to insult, the Jotunheim crew is shock to learn that the Federation already knows the Zudah's shameful background — it is nothing but a repainted version of the failed project that previously lost the bid to Zaku I due to a lethal design flaw. The Zudah is doomed to lose all honor and become a ghost fighter.

programmes.title: Mobile Suit Gundam MS IGLOO
programmes.episode_title: I Saw The Ocean In Jaburo's Skies
programmes.description: (U.C. 0079.12.03 - 0079.12.07) With Zeon losing their foothold on Earth, the 603rd is given a new project — to infiltrate a prototype weapon into the Federation airspace and attack Federation warships launching from Jaburo. Ensign Werner Holbein, an arrogant naval officer who boasts a proud maritime family tradition, is assigned to the Jotunheim to pilot the mobile diver unit Ze'Gok. However, the testing goes well below expectation, as both Holbein's test drop ends in failure after unable to score any hit with the Ze'Gok. On the third and final drop, Holbein manages to destroy a handful of Federation ships with a direct reentry/free descent before letting loose the attached "Kuhblume" beam scatter cannon. Before he could celebrate, two Core Booster II fighters arrived and shot down both the Ze'Gok and the retrieving Gaw carrier, killing Holbein in the process.

programmes.title: After War Gundam X

As Garrod gets closer to the moon, the defense system of the lunar base sends up its mobile bits to escort him safely to the surface, and gather all those that are needed for the special meeting. The leaders of the SRA and New UNE call a cease fire as they head to the moon under the protected escort of the lunar defense system, to finally meet with the object they are fighting over ... D.O.M.E.

programmes.title: After War Gundam X

programmes.description: D.O.M.E. introduces himself to the group of pilots and leaders, telling them all exactly what they must do in order to make the future that they want to come true, and that the idealogy that they hold onto about Newtypes is nothing but a fabrication. Devestated by the news of what D.O.M.E. has to say the leaders of the SRA and New UNE are unsure what to do next as they finally understand. Leaving the moon, the three ships find that the war has restarted due to the Frost brothers, and a final battle between Garrod Ran and the two brothers errupts as they pit Satellite Cannon against Satellite Launcher.

The Freedom and Justice arrive at the battlefield in time to destroy all the nuclear warheads. In retaliation, Patrick Zala orders to fire the GENESIS.

Kira destroys the Providence with the Freedom, while Athrun remote-destructs the Justice to destroys GENESIS. With both the PLANTs and the Earth Alliance forces in disarray, the renegade moderate faction of the PLANTs seize the opportunity to call for a cease-fire, effectively ending the war.

programmes.title: Mobile Suit Gundam SEED

But something goes wrong with the memory implantation and he remembers being a secret agent fighting against the evil Mars administrator Cohaagen. Now the story really begins and it's a rollercoaster ride until the massive end of the movie.

When Phoenix escapes 36 years later to wreak havoc on the future, Spartan is awakened to capture his nemesis the old-fashioned way.

Things turn south when the news crew arm themselves and hold the Prometheus, as well as Sam and Jonas, hostage.

programmes.title: Stargate Atlantis
